original_title: China Box Office: ‘Resident Evil’ Dethrones ‘Traces of Justice’ to Claim Top Spot as Post-Holiday Market Cools
summary_en: The chilling grip of the **Resident Evil** reboot has seized the top spot at the Chinese box office, unseating the previously dominant **Traces of Justice**. This shift signals a cooling post-holiday market and a strong international debut for the horror franchise.
ai_analysis: This box office shift highlights the enduring global appeal of established horror franchises and their ability to capture audience attention even in diverse international markets.

en.title: Resident Evil Horror Reboot Dethrones Top Chinese Film as Market Cools
en.summary: The chilling grip of the **Resident Evil** reboot has seized the top spot at the Chinese box office, unseating the previously dominant **Traces of Justice**. This shift signals a cooling post-holiday market and a strong international debut for the horror franchise.
en.body:
The mainland China box office saw a significant shake-up this past weekend as Constantin Film and Sony Pictures’ **Resident Evil** reboot clawed its way to the number one position. Grossing an impressive RMB81.2 million (approximately $12.1 million) over the three-day frame, the horror film has officially dethroned **Traces of Justice**, which had held the top spot. This move comes as the post-Golden Week holiday market experiences a natural cooldown.

Launched on October 5th, the **Resident Evil** reboot’s success in China is a testament to the franchise's broad appeal, even as the Chinese film market navigates its post-holiday rhythm. While specific details on the game engine powering the film's visual effects or the director's specific influences from the source material are not readily available, the film's ability to draw audiences suggests a strong connection with fans of the survival horror genre.

## A New Champion Emerges

Following its October 5th rollout, **Resident Evil** quickly made its mark. Data from Artisan Gateway confirms its leading performance for the weekend of October 9-11. This victory is particularly noteworthy given the established presence of **Traces of Justice**, a film that had previously commanded significant audience attention. The successful international launch of **Resident Evil** is a critical win for Constantin Film and Sony Pictures, demonstrating the franchise's continued power to attract viewers worldwide.

## Fan Anticipation and Global Reach

The international reception for **Resident Evil** is being closely watched by fans globally. The film's performance in China not only boosts its immediate box office standing but also sets a positive tone for its upcoming releases in other territories. **Traces of Justice**, meanwhile, is gearing up for its own international expansion, with a release slated for the UK and Ireland on October 30th, 2026. This exchange at the top of the box office charts underscores the dynamic nature of global cinema and the passionate fanbases that drive these popular titles.

## What's Next

With **Resident Evil** now leading the charge in China, all eyes will be on its sustained performance and how it fares against upcoming releases. The continued success of **Traces of Justice** in its new territories will also be a key point to monitor in the coming weeks.
